author: Seung Wook
problem: Read an R by C board of '.', '#' and digits 1-9 (bombs). All bombs explode at once: a bomb with power p turns every square within Manhattan distance p (including its own) into '.'. Print the board afterwards; squares not reached keep their original character.
bug_description: Unreached non-bomb squares are set to '#' instead of their original character, so untouched '.' squares turn into walls.

comments.accurate: Explodes every bomb, clearing squares within its Manhattan range, and prints the resulting board
comments.wrong_behavior: Explodes every bomb, clearing squares within its Manhattan range; any square no blast reaches is shown as a wall
comments.wrong_location: Unreached squares handled; check the Manhattan range loops near the board edges
